summary: Backend-only iteration 23 tests: (1) Deployment health probe /health (no /api prefix) at backend port 8001, (2) customer search endpoint by name/phone with is_mine + limit clamp + cross-assignee visibility, (3) reference_no on linked_receipts across sales/collections/invoices/daybook + regression on lookup, ledger, and pdf_token. 19/19 tests pass.
action_items: NOTE for main agent: /health is a root-level FastAPI route on the backend (port 8001). K8s ingress only routes /api/* to backend (everything else goes to Expo frontend on 3000). So /health on the public URL returns the Expo HTML page, NOT the backend JSON. This is fine for k8s liveness/readiness probes (they hit the pod directly on port 8001), but if the deploy platform's probe is external (going through ingress), it will still 200 (Expo HTML) — but will NOT be the JSON health probe. Confirm the deployment platform's probe strategy. Tests verified /health works correctly at backend:8001 as expected.
No fixes required in server.py — all new features function correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3468 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into modules (auth, customers, sales, invoices, receipts, daybook, admin) for maintainability. Not blocking.

customers/search uses `int(limit or 20)` which treats limit=0 as falsy and defaults to 20 rather than clamping to 1 as one might expect. Behavior is safe (no crash, upper cap 100 works) but slightly non-intuitive. Tests adjusted to reflect actual behavior.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral TEST_ prefixed customers, one sale, one collection, one invoice, and three receipts (with reference_no values REF-XYZ-123, COLLREF-*, INVREF-*) during test run. Customer created by emp2 cleaned up via admin DELETE.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_iteration23_search_health_refs.py for regression of: (a) /health probe (backend port 8001 only), (b) /api/customers/search (name+phone+is_mine+visibility+limit clamp), (c) linked_receipts reference_no field across sales/collections/invoices/daybook, plus /customers/lookup and /customers/{id}/ledger regressions. Env var EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is read from frontend/.env; export it before running pytest.
